verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a GraphQL API with self-serve API keys (copied from the Integrations section and sent as a Bearer token), plus `transcripts` and `transcript` queries that scripts can use to pull meeting transcripts with filters. The evidence shows summaries and action items only as app/marketing features, not as documented API fields or queries, so only the transcript part of the story is evidenced at the API level. missing for 10: documented API fields for summaries and action items, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk extraction across every meeting, an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (the probe returned 404, though GraphQL introspection exists).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: Navigate to the Integrations section 3. Click on Fireflies API 4. Copy and store your API key securely
We use a standard bearer token authentication mechanism.
The transcripts query is designed to fetch a list of transcripts against input arguments.
The transcript query is designed to fetch details associated with a specific transcript ID.
This API allows you to retrieve exactly the data you need in a structured format.
